title: Report Filing Channel and the Paper Filing Factor in Penalty Relief
content:
1. On the Employer Unemployment Insurance Tax Accounts, the full penalty paid in a penalty relief request is multiplied by a paper filing factor.
2. The factor follows how the relieved quarter's original report — the original report for that quarter with the latest filing date — was filed, together with the number of original reports the employer filed through the online portal within the portal lookback months, 12.
3. A report filed on paper by an employer that filed at least two original reports through the online portal within the 12 months is multiplied by 0.75.
4. A report filed on paper by an employer that filed exactly one original report through the online portal within the 12 months is multiplied by 0.9.
5. Any other report is not multiplied: a paper report with no online portal filing in the 12 months, and every report filed through a channel other than paper.
6. The 12 months are counted in whole months back from the day of the request, by the filing dates of the reports. Only original reports count toward the online portal filings.

**Points of judgement (hypothetical employers, penalty paid USD 100.00).**

- Relieved report on paper; three original reports through the online portal within 12 months: multiplied by 0.75, giving USD 75.00.
- Relieved report on paper; one portal filing within 12 months and two more filed 15 months before the request: only one lies within the 12 months, so it is multiplied by 0.9, giving USD 90.00.
- Relieved report on paper; no portal filing within 12 months: not multiplied, USD 100.00.
- Relieved report filed through the online portal: not multiplied, USD 100.00, however many portal filings there are.
